title: E6 floor is pinned at proc level only — the floored value is never asserted end-to-end through flow_step into lane_caps
evidence:
core/qos_test.odin:110-113 (white-box test calls qos_pipe_caps DIRECTLY after forcing weights; no step_n after the force, so s.flow.lane_caps never carries the floored result):
	ps := u32(0)
	s.topology.pipe_weights[ps] = {0, 1, 1}
	caps := qos_pipe_caps(&s.topology, cat, ps, s.topology.pipe_id[ps])
	testing.expectf(t, caps[LANE_EXPRESS] == 1,
		"E6: never-drop Express lane floored to 1, got %v", caps)

core/qos_test.odin:195-197 — the only lane_caps assert uses the NON-never-drop catalog:
	// flow lane_caps: the derived buffer follows (gen-triggered rebuild)
	step_n(&s, 1, cat)
	testing.expect_value(t, s.flow.lane_caps[0], [3]u32{9, 4, 2}) // express_heavy on cap 15
detail: E6's floor contract is pinned (test_qos_apply_floor_e6 + qos_pipe_caps is the exact flow_step callee), but the gen-triggered rebuild path never demonstrates a floored lane_caps buffer; the flow-level seam is untested.
recommended_fix: In test_qos_pipe_caps_flow_floor_e6, force weights then step_n and assert s.flow.lane_caps[0][LANE_EXPRESS] == 1 (plus the truncation twin on a tiny tier).
